Test KeePass databases created by KeePass / KeePassXC (synthetic data, public test material).

Source: keepass-rs test resources (https://github.com/sseemayer/keepass-rs, tests/resources), MIT License,
Copyright (c) 2019 Stefan Seemayer. Passwords and expected values come from keepass-rs tests:
`demopass` (most files), `password` (kdbx3_with_chacha20_protected_fields), `test` (kdbx4_with_totp_entry);
`test_key.key`, `test_key_xml.key` and `*.keyx` are the matching key files.
